description:
### Gboard

GboardPatches Community 3.12.7

Commit: `165122d377edf319fddaf3e83fa04e4c54e53dbd`

Six independent native editing Access Points: Select All, Copy, Cut, Paste, Undo and Redo.

Undo/Redo keep their own bounded, per-field history of the edits the keyboard sends (typing grouped by word, composition and autocorrect, backspace runs, pastes). Any change the keyboard did not make discards that history; only the exact recorded state is ever reversed. Password/no-learning fields and Undo-off record nothing. When no keyboard history applies, the toolbar Paste/Cut journal and then the app's own undo are used.

Contextual toolbar: while suggestions are shown, the shortcuts key toggles the native favorites row instead of opening the full panel over the keys.

Clipboard search: the old in-panel mini keypad was removed. The new search (results above, native alphabet keyboard below) is implemented but stays disabled until its 18.0.3 keyboard-switch and connection-restore bindings are verified on device, so this bundle has no clipboard search. Retention limits and themes are unchanged.

Device validation remains pending on Gboard 18.0.3. This bundle does not add 18.5.1 support.
